description: Source code for certificate verification utility functions, including reading, parsing, and handling certificates in DER and PEM formats, with platform-specific trust store debugging.

methods.name: ExtractCertificatesFromData
methods.description: Parses input data as PEM, PKCS#7, or DER certificates and populates a vector of CertInput objects.

methods.name: ReadCertificatesFromFile
methods.description: Reads certificate data from a file and extracts certificates.

methods.name: ReadChainFromFile
methods.description: Reads a certificate chain from a file, separating target and intermediates.

methods.name: ReadFromFile
methods.description: Reads file contents into a string.

methods.name: WriteToFile
methods.description: Writes data to a specified file.

methods.name: PrintCertError
methods.description: Outputs an error message related to a certificate.

methods.name: PrintDebugData
methods.description: Outputs debug information about trust store data on macOS.

methods.name: FingerPrintCryptoBuffer
methods.description: Calculates SHA256 fingerprint of a certificate buffer.

methods.name: SubjectFromX509Certificate
methods.description: Extracts the subject display name from an X509Certificate object.

methods.name: SubjectFromCryptoBuffer
methods.description: Creates an X509Certificate from a buffer and extracts its subject display name.
